mechanism_narrative: A high level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) as of t-1mo indicates a robust labor market, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for PAYEMS as a predictor of 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals an overheating labor market, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) and Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% indicate aggressive monetary tightening in response to high inflation, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized and UNRATE < 4.5%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals economic cooling, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime, when HOUST declines > 0.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index base 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, which typically results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail and food services sales (RSAFS) above $470,000 million signals strong consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 470000, the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the monetary tightening cycle regime, when INDPRO < 105.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 245.0 (index base 1982-1984=100) signals persistent inflation, which typically triggers Federal Reserve rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 245.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases.
